elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: The clause applies “Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason” and requires Garman, at Sparkling’s request, to provide transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six (6) months.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly provides transition assistance “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor’s then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The assistance is expressly priced “at Garman’s then-current rates.”

elements.element: Vendor must return Customer Data following expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Garman must “return all of Sparkling’s data” following expiry or termination.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The return is required “within thirty (30) calendar days of such expiry or termination.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly requires return “in a standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: Vendor must delete Customer Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: After return, Garman must “delete Sparkling’s data from its systems.”

elements.element: Vendor must certify the deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: After return and deletion, Garman must “certify such deletion in writing.”

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: The clause requires transition assistance upon expiry or termination for any reason, at Sparkling’s request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for at least ninety (90) days.
elements.evidence: Availability for up to six months permits Sparkling to obtain ninety days of assistance and exceeds the fallback duration.

elements.element: Vendor must export or return Customer Data following expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Garman must return all of Sparkling’s data following expiry or termination.

elements.element: The Customer Data export must occur within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause requires return within thirty calendar days of expiry or termination.

result.reason: The added transition provision satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also the fallback. However, the redline separately adds “not yet rendered” to the existing fee-refund language. That unrelated change materially narrows Garman’s refund obligation and is unnecessary to implement the transition position. Accordingly, the redline is neither minimal nor fully preservative of unrelated commercial intent. Drafting quality is also reduced by the clause’s pre-existing fragmentary structure and the absence of a clear subsection designation for the new transition provision.
